gates.name: Intake and scope
gates.appliesWhen: Every new content request or changed brief.
passCriteria: The goal or applicant problem is usable.
The audience is explicit or the approved HireNudge audience default is recorded.
Requested channel, format, country, route or module constraints are recorded without invention.
failureAction: Ask one focused question or apply only the documented audience default.
Do not create Drive records.

gates.name: Evidence eligibility
gates.appliesWhen: Every candidate idea before it is described as approval-ready.
gates.checkpoint: Before Priyansh sees an approval-ready option and before drafting.
passCriteria: The idea begins with an original job source, consented anonymised case, attributable recruiter observation or verified product or labour-market data.
The source, date and material limitations are available.
failureAction: Remove or replace the candidate.
Do not send unsupported options to Priyansh as approval-ready.

gates.name: Product Truth
gates.appliesWhen: A treatment names, shows or implies a HireNudge capability or product outcome.
gates.checkpoint: Before product-led ideation, before drafting and during final editorial review.
passCriteria: The current Product Truth capability and related claim decision were read.
Safe wording and all limitations are preserved.
No non-live status is upgraded and no blocked claim is used.
failureAction: Remove the product claim, narrow it to safe wording or request product-owner or production verification.
Block contradictory or unknown capability claims.

gates.name: Channel-treatment approval
gates.appliesWhen: A proposed channel treatment could become an operational record.
gates.checkpoint: Before any tracker row or production Doc is created.
passCriteria: Priyansh explicitly approves the exact channel, topic, approach, category and format.
failureAction: Keep the proposal in chat.
Do not issue an Operations write command.

gates.name: Duplicate and reuse control
gates.appliesWhen: Before artifact creation and before any later-week subject reuse.
passCriteria: The treatment does not violate active Concept Key, Hook Key or Parent Pack reuse rules.
A matching approved record is reused instead of silently duplicated.
failureAction: Reframe the concept or reuse the matching approved record.
Refer any proposed duplicate-control replacement to the Content Systems Architect.

gates.name: Operations write authorisation
gates.appliesWhen: Immediately before every tracker or production-Doc mutation.
gates.checkpoint: Before the write, link update or status transition.
passCriteria: Required upstream gates passed.
The live schema matches the manifest and expected six-column contract.
The operation is idempotent and the requested transition is permitted.
failureAction: Make no mutation and preserve the current state.
Return the exact unmet condition and observed identifiers.

gates.name: Production completeness
gates.appliesWhen: A draft requests movement from Drafting to Review.
gates.checkpoint: Before Editorial & Trust receives the asset.
passCriteria: The production Doc contains only the final asset material, required display text, applicable visual instructions, one CTA and source links.
Narrated work specifies human narration and product wording preserves G2.
failureAction: Keep the asset in Drafting.
Return the exact missing fields to Copy & Production.

gates.name: Editorial and trust
gates.appliesWhen: Every asset in Review before it can become Ready.
gates.checkpoint: After production completeness and before final human approval.
passCriteria: Sources support material claims.
Product Truth, privacy, consent, natural language, usefulness, duplication and platform fit pass.
The Review Report explicitly returns Pass.
failureAction: Return Revise with exact line, reason, correction and responsible role, or Block when the issue cannot be repaired.
Keep the asset in Review.

gates.name: Final human approval
passCriteria: Priyansh explicitly approves the finished asset for the next human-controlled action.
failureAction: Return the asset to the named specialist or hold it at Ready.
Do not schedule, publish or mark Published.

gates.name: YouTube phase gate
gates.appliesWhen: A YouTube treatment is proposed for production or the YouTube phase is reconsidered.
gates.checkpoint: Before G3 approval is requested for YouTube production.
passCriteria: At least three comparable short-form executions show a repeatable applicant decision, strong evidence and credible human production capacity.
failureAction: Keep YouTube in research or Phase 2.
Do not treat calendar time alone as a pass.
